event: President's Media Division announces phased lifting of the vehicle import suspension
Stage 1: public passenger transport vehicles, special purpose vehicles and other non-motorised goods allowed
Stage 2: commercial and goods transport vehicles allowed

Stage 3: personal-use vehicles (cars, vans, SUVs, pickups) allowed; 50% surcharge on customs import duty for personal vehicles; new luxury tax; individuals limited to one vehicle per 12 months; separate gazettes revised EV taxes
ev_relevance_hypothesis: Main reopening: new-car supply returns, total new registrations jump (362,100 in 2025 vs 74,410 in 2024), EV share of new cars falls (32.6% to 10.4%). Association only
source_title: Daily FT, 14 Sep 2024 (schedule) and AIR News, 1 Feb 2025 (tax details)
notes: AIR article gives no base duty rates or EV rates. Read the actual gazette (check Treasury / Department of Customs) before quoting rates
